the direct supply of energy to the reaction mixture during microwave-assisted hydrothermal and combustion synthesis of inorganic materials can lead to a better control of the reaction parameters and, hence, to the synthesis of novel materials with unique properties.

the direct energy supply to the reaction mixture during microwave-assisted hydrothermal and combustion synthesis of inorganic materials can be used to control the morphology and size of the final products.
